title: CONSTRUCTION PLOT
body: Render the IDLE material-funded construction plot in the reference crop. A flat cool medium-gray rounded-square decal (snow-side marker color), with exactly FOUR separated short white rounded corner brackets, open middle of every edge, no continuous border. Centered white castle/camp pictogram: broad low crenellated fort front with a small arched central doorway and two small dark square window holes toward its upper portion. Treat it as ONE flat painted icon; no actual building or height. At its front edge: one small brown log resource pictogram with golden cut end, followed by white '200'. Match reference glyph and log icon. No dollar symbol, cash or progress. Reference background snow and partial actor are excluded; isolated on navy sheet. Title HAVENLINE / CONSTRUCTION PLOT, subtitle REFERENCE MATERIAL COST EXAMPLE. All8 panels are the SAME IDLE gray state, never green. POSITION MAP FOR THE FIXED FRONT PRICE EDGE: in0 it is nearBOTTOM CENTER;45 nearLOWER LEFT diagonal;90LEFTside vertically;135FAR UPPER LEFT diagonal;180FAR TOP CENTER upside down;225FAR UPPER RIGHT diagonal;270RIGHTside vertically opposite90;315nearLOWER RIGHT diagonal. IMPORTANT225and315mustNOTrepeat:225priceatUPPER-RIGHTfar edge,315priceatLOWER-RIGHTnear edge.135musthavepriceUPPER-LEFTfar edge. Attach the entire painted icon andprice rigidly tooneplane so allrotate together. At180rotateeveryglyph180degrees; never turn it back upright for readability. Theoutsidepanelcaptions stayupright. This is an orbit around a square plane, not eight duplicate front-facing cards. Replace dollar text in this compass with the log icon, followed by200. The castle, resource icon and200 rotate together as one ground marking, so they are upside down at180. Keep exact same icon shapes and order throughout.

title: WORK ZONE
body: Render the ACTIVE work-zone boundary shown in the second source crop. One elongated rounded RECTANGLE footprint about2:1 width-to-depth, drawn only with disconnected bright leaf-green outline segments. Its interior stays EMPTY and UNFILLED: the navy studio ground is visible inside exactly as outside. The outline consists of four rounded corner curves, THREE short straight dashes on each long side, ONE short straight dash on each short end. Exactly12 separated pieces, stable layout in all8 views. No square brown payment pad, no interior green fill, no solid rim, no glyph, no resource symbol, no amount, no checkmark, no character. Nearly flush ground paint with minimal thickness, no raised platform. Keep the rectangle geometry and12-piece pattern invariant while the camera goes around it; wide at0/180, end-on narrower at90/270, distinct opposing diagonals. Title HAVENLINE / WORK ZONE, subtitle ACTIVE STATE / UNFILLED INTERIOR. The source character and fishing gear are not included.
